title: Image-Perfect Imperfections: Safety, Bias, and Authenticity in the Shadow of Text-To-Image Model Evolution
reasoning: The paper comprehensively benchmarks and evaluates AI safety and bias across multiple versions of Stable Diffusion. Its safety evaluation specifically measures 'hateful' and 'political' content, and its bias evaluation focuses on gender and racial stereotypes, which are core dimensions of benchmarking AI ethics and societal impact.
